description: Phase 10 Streamlit interface (D8). The app reuses the frozen components: the parser, constrained selection (configs/solver.json) and explanations. The demo cases are hand-written for the interface; none comes from a benchmark file.
fallback_reason: the transformer needs the DistilBERT checkpoints in models/nlu/transformer/ (not in git); without them the app uses the E0 baseline parser and says so
